description: The line plot illustrates the mean interclass similarity across various relation categories, comparing different configurations of a relation extraction model. The x-axis, labeled "Relation Category," ranges from 0 to 60, likely representing different types of relations or categories in the dataset. The y-axis, labeled "Mean Interclass Similarity," ranges from 0 to 0.5, indicating the degree of similarity between different classes within each relation category. The plot includes five lines, each representing a different configuration of the model: "w/o DPO obo," "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint," "DPO," "Average of w/o DPO obo," and "Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint." The "w/o DPO obo" line is blue with a solid line style, the "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint" line is orange with a dashed line style, the "DPO" line is green with a dash-dot line style, the "Average of w/o DPO obo" line is blue with a dotted line style, and the "Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint" line is orange with a dash-dot line style. The plot shows variability in mean interclass similarity across different relation categories, with some peaks and declines, indicating differences in how the model configurations perform in terms of class similarity within each category.
